creator: Matt Muir / Web Curios
reason: Explicitly welcomes creator submissions; previously covered The 24h Homepage and replaceable homepage slots.
subject: A homepage with one owner, until someone replaces them
text:
Hi Matt,

I read your Curios item about The 24h Homepage. I built a related internet experiment with a different constraint: one shared homepage, one owner at a time, and the next takeover replaces the previous one. No time-slot grid.

It's called Take The Wall: https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=webcurios&utm_medium=editorial_pitch&utm_campaign=wall_demo

The question is what someone would put on that single spot: a project, a message, or something ridiculous. Watching is free; publishing a takeover is paid. The site also has milestone rewards governed by its published rules.

I've attached a 15-second, clearly labeled example animation so you can see the replacement mechanic without making a purchase. It's also here: https://x.com/serhansarii/status/2098881087174803759

Would this fit a future Curios edition? This is an editorial suggestion, with no sponsored placement requested.

Thanks,
Take The Wall
